name: @boperators/mcp-server

tools.name: list_overloads
tools.description: List all registered operator overloads in a boperators project. Returns class names, operators, parameter types, and whether they are static or instance.

tsconfig.description: Absolute path to tsconfig.json for the project.

tools.name: transform_preview
tools.description: Preview the result of boperators transformation on a file or a line range within it. When startLine/endLine are given, only the relevant slice of original and transformed text is returned, keeping token usage low.

tsconfig.description: Absolute path to tsconfig.json for the project.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the TypeScript file to transform.

startLine.description: First line to include (1-based, inclusive). Omit for full file.

endLine.description: Last line to include (1-based, inclusive). Omit for full file.

tools.name: scaffold_overloads
tools.description: Generate TypeScript boilerplate for operator overload definitions on a class. Returns code ready to paste into a class body, with correct static/instance placement and parameter types.

className.description: The class name to generate overloads for.

tools.name: validate_overloads
tools.description: Validate operator overload definitions in a single file. Returns structured diagnostics: errors (wrong arity, bad types) and warnings (e.g. conflicting overloads). Does not transform the file.

tsconfig.description: Absolute path to tsconfig.json for the project.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the TypeScript file to validate.

tools.name: explain_expression
tools.description: Explain a transformed boperators expression. Given an expression like Vec2["+"](a, b) or a["+="](b) or a["++"](), identifies the operator kind, class, and overload entry. Optionally looks up full overload metadata when tsconfig is provided.

expression.description: The transformed expression to explain, e.g. 'Vec2["+"](a, b)'.

tsconfig.description: Absolute path to tsconfig.json. When provided, the overload is looked up in the project for richer metadata (file path, parameter types).

stderr: boperators MCP server running on stdio
